title: HE WALKED FROM CHILE TO HULL FOR 28 YEARS. NO BUSES, NO TRAINS, NO LIFTS
description:
In 1998 he left Chile on foot. The destination was Hull.

Karl Bushby covered about 31,000 miles across four continents. His rules: no buses, no trains, no lifts, and no coming home until he finished. On 5 October he swam the Channel to start the final leg. A ferry would have been cheating.

Hull City urged fans to welcome him at City Hall. After the 2-2 draw with Ipswich, the club posted his video in a Hull shirt. Now he hopes to watch a match at the MKM Stadium. Sitting down.
